high_level_description: This image is a black-and-white cover of Vogue Korea magazine. The central figure is a person with long, flowing hair, wearing a textured, dark-colored dress that appears to be made of leather or a similar material. The individual is posing with one hand raised above their head, partially obscuring their face, which adds an air of mystery and elegance to the photograph. The text on the cover includes "VOGUE KOREA" prominently displayed at the top in large, bold letters.
